name: Lateral Medicine Ball Throw
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall, holding a medicine ball with both hands.
Load by rotating the torso away from the wall.
Explosively rotate toward the wall and release the ball at chest height.
Follow through with the hips. A rotational power developer.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: Lateral Medicine Ball Throw is an intermediate pushing exercise for the abs, performed with minimal equipment. Pressing strength keeps daily pushing tasks — and your shoulders — working well for decades.
